data.title: Merge prototypes pipeline into parallax: data layer + publish.mjs repoint

data.body: Wave-1 done, staged (NOT committed) for review. Added src/data/works.json (4-entry seed), getAllWorks()+Work in src/lib/content.ts, 4 gifs in public/lab/, migrated pipeline/ + repointed publish.mjs (works.json manifest, public/lab dest, /lab web paths, content: commit msgs, parallax.haus SITE_URL, --url support), .gitignore pipeline ignores, updated /post-prototype command. Verified: --no-push --no-tweet re-publish updated works.json + gif correctly; reverted the resulting commit (publish.mjs commits by design) and restored clean seed (sha matches); npx tsc --noEmit exit 0. pipeline/.env confirmed gitignored. NOTE for Julianna: publish.mjs commits by design (only push is --no-push gated); running it during this staged merge creates a commit that must be reset.
